title: PA intake graph where no denial is ever automatic
scenario: Kestrel Health Plan's hackathon LangGraph prototype copies the model's outcome into the determination, so a model can deny care. Rebuild it so that only a confident, fully cited approval finalizes automatically and every denial, pend, low-confidence or invalid recommendation and eligibility problem waits at an interrupt for a reviewer, resumable from a SQLite checkpoint in a new process.
task: Add check_completeness, request_info, human_review and the routing between them
Validate model output with the Pydantic Recommendation contract; invalid output goes to review
Validate reviewer input (reviewer, specific reason for deny/pend) and loop on bad input
Make finalize() refuse to deny or pend without a human decision
acceptance: Every adverse or uncertain path stops at human_review with the right reason
Exhaustive drive over all cases never yields an adverse outcome decided by auto
Resume from a SQLite checkpoint in a new graph without calling the model again
